Title: Psycho-Electrophysiological Benefits of Forest Therapies Focused on Qigong and Walking with Elderly Individuals
Journal: Int J Environ Res Public Health
Abstract: The investigated variables were fat-free mass (FFM), body fat mass (BFM), percent body fat (%BF = BFM/(FFM + BFM)), the <m>impedances</m>, <m>reactances</m>, and <m>phase</m> <m>angles</m> (PhAs) of the arms (Imp_arm, Reactance_arm and PhA_arm) and legs (Imp_leg, Reactance_leg and PhA_leg), and the <m>phase</m> <m>angle</m> of the whole body (PhA_body) (details are presented in Table A1).
